subject: 集安丸都山城 · 石砌瞭望台正面
name: 集安丸都山城
sub: 石砌瞭望台 · 高句丽山城
yearNote: 公元3年筑尉那岩城，山上王于198年扩建并更名丸都城，209年迁都于此；年份取198年扩建作约略定位。瞭望台本体的筑造年代、尺寸与修缮情况未查到单独记载，现状下部砌石整齐处可能经近代归安，图版按2023年实拍现状绘制，不复原塌落部分。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q5371879（丸都山城 Hwando）P625 坐标 41.146527, 126.157111，山城近似坐标，非瞭望台实测；地图显示点复用既有 jian_jilin（集安）。
lede: 集安城西的山谷里，高句丽的丸都山城沿山脊围出六千三百余米的石砌城垣，198年山上王扩建此城，209年迁都于此，244年与342年两度被攻破。城内这座石砌瞭望台由大块方整的灰红花岗岩层层叠起，上部已塌落成乱石堆，是山城里最醒目的一处遗存。
facts: 年代：公元3年初筑尉那岩城，198年山上王扩建更名丸都城，209年迁都；1982年以“丸都山故城”列第二批国保，2001年国内城并入，2004年列入世界遗产。
形制：城垣周长6395米，平面不规则四边形，北高南低，东、西、北三面临绝壁；城门六处，宫殿遗址在城内东侧山坡下。瞭望台为石块层层内收的台状建筑，上部塌毁，尺寸未查到。
图版：以2023年10月正面实拍定台体轮廓与砌石层次，参照同年6月斜侧实拍核对台角；说明牌、护栏与植被去除，不复原塌落部分。
caption: 丸都山城 · 石砌瞭望台
高句丽 · 198
structure_checkpoints: 整体：一座近似梯形轮廓的石砌台体，底边最宽、向上逐层内收，左右两侧坡度不同（左侧坍塌较多、轮廓更缓，右侧较陡）。
砌石：下部三至四层为规整的长方形楔形石块顺砌，缝隙明显；中部右侧仍保留整齐的层砌面，中部左侧与顶部为塌落后的乱石堆。
台顶：无建筑残存，仅乱石；台体中部正面有一块现代“保护文物 禁止攀登”牌（去除）。
台前：草地与一块斜立的现代说明牌（去除）；台后为山坡与树木（去除）。2023年6月斜侧照片显示台体右侧角部砌石层数与正面一致。
material_observations: 石块为灰色至淡红褐色花岗岩，表面粗糙、棱角分明；石缝间长有杂草与小灌木；台前草地黄绿；无灰浆。
author: EditQ（호고호）

additional_sources.author: Yumeto
additional_sources.role: 2023年6月斜侧视角，核对台角砌石层次与整体体量；不作正面几何依据。

source_note: 主图为 EditQ 2023 年 10 月正面实拍（CC BY-SA 4.0），Commons 名为 Lookout Tower；补充图为 Yumeto 2023 年 6 月斜侧实拍（CC BY-SA 4.0）。瞭望台的文献尺寸与修缮记录未查到（baike 403、UNESCO 页 403），facts 只写“尺寸未查到”。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the stone lookout platform (瞭望台) inside Wandu Mountain City (丸都山城), Ji'an, Jilin, a Goguryeo fortress, drawn straight on from Image 2 (2023 frontal photo); Image 3 is an oblique view for the corner construction only. A low, broad, roughly trapezoidal mound of dry-laid dressed granite blocks: three or four neat horizontal courses of rectangular blocks at the bottom, a still-regular stepped masonry face on the middle right, and tumbled loose blocks on the middle left and over the collapsed top. Keep the irregular, partly ruined outline exactly as photographed – do not reconstruct a complete pyramid. Draw the block joints sparsely. Remove the two modern sign boards, the grass texture, the trees and the hills behind; use only a few short ground lines. Landscape 1536×1024, mound about 82% of width.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
